sentences.en: A human body consists of a countless number of cells.
sentences.zh: 人体由无数个细胞组成。

sentences.en: In fact, there are countless, varied uses for the Internet.
sentences.zh: 事实上，互联网有数不尽的各种用途。

sentences.en: Countless people wait their turn in front of the butcher's.
sentences.zh: 无数的人在肉铺前排队等候。

senses.zh: 无数的，多得数不清的,恒河沙数,指不胜屈,数不胜数
